mapper.sql: id, user_id, nickname, score, max_tile, max_character, move_count, duration_seconds, board_state, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sekai_2048_game_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY score DESC, max_tile DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.nickname, r.score, r.max_tile, r.max_character, r.move_count, r.duration_seconds, r.board_state, r.create_time, u.vip_level, u.vip_expire_time FROM sekai_2048_game_record r LEFT JOIN sekai_2048_user u ON u.id = r.user_id ORDER BY r.score DESC, r.max_tile DESC, r.duration_seconds ASC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalRuns, COALESCE(SUM(move_count), 0) AS totalMoves, COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds), 0) AS totalSeconds, COALESCE(MAX(score), 0) AS bestScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score)), 0) AS averageScore, COALESCE(MAX(max_tile), 0) AS bestTile FROM sekai_2048_game_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT max_character FROM sekai_2048_game_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY max_character ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, MAX(score) DESC LIMIT 1
